about: Every tunable parameter of code-scrap. surface = the one place a setting is changed in the UI (display = viewport ☰ menu, view = View tab, toolbar = top bar); settings without a surface are tunables shown in the settings panel. Viewers generate their settings panel from this file; presets override defaults by id. scope: viewer = applied by the viewer, server = sent to scrap via the options op.

settings.label: Theme
settings.desc: Look of panels and controls. Themes live in config/themes.

settings.label: Scale with display
settings.desc: Follow the operating system's display scale (DPI).

settings.label: Interface scale
settings.desc: Size of all panels, controls and text. Multiplies the display scale when scaling with the display.

settings.label: Explorer
settings.desc: The file tree on the left (toolbar toggle).

settings.label: Mouse & keys
settings.desc: Navigation and shortcut scheme. Keymaps live in config/keymaps.

settings.label: Labels
settings.desc: Directory, file and scope names on the boxes.

settings.label: Code text
settings.desc: The source text printed inside files (dashes far away, letters up close).

settings.label: Line numbers
settings.desc: A gutter with line numbers left of the code, like an editor.

settings.label: Hover highlight
settings.desc: Outline the box under the cursor.

settings.label: Search highlights
settings.desc: Tint files and lines that match the current search.

settings.label: Relation arcs
settings.desc: Draw import and call arcs when those overlays are on.

settings.label: Legend
settings.desc: Explain the current colors and arcs in the viewport corner.

settings.label: Viewport header
settings.desc: Breadcrumb of the selection with camera and display menus.

settings.label: Ground grid
settings.desc: Dotted ground plane and horizon glow around the map.

settings.label: Minimap
settings.desc: The whole repository in a corner with the current view marked; click or drag it to move there.

settings.label: Wheel zoom step
settings.desc: Zoom factor per wheel notch.

settings.label: Zoom smoothing
settings.desc: How fast the camera catches up with wheel zoom. Higher = snappier.

settings.label: Fly speed
settings.desc: Speed of animated flights (search hits, framing, home).

settings.label: Orbit speed
settings.desc: 3D rotation per pixel of mouse drag.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.desc: Vertical field of view of the 3D camera, in degrees.

settings.label: Fly to search results
settings.desc: Selecting a search result moves the camera to it. Off keeps the camera where it is.

settings.label: Reading assist
settings.desc: 3D: as code becomes readable, tilt toward a top-down view (and back when you pull out). 0 = off.

settings.label: Label size
settings.desc: Font size of directory, file and scope labels in the viewport (before interface scale).

settings.label: Label budget
settings.desc: Most labels drawn at once; bigger boxes win.

settings.label: Smallest labelled box
settings.desc: Boxes narrower than this on screen get no label.

settings.label: Label spacing
settings.desc: Free space kept between labels (px): higher = fewer, calmer labels.

settings.label: Folder names on walls
settings.desc: 3D: print folder names on the terrace wall facing you, like a sign; otherwise they float at the roof edge.

settings.label: Hidden labels
settings.desc: 3D labels behind buildings: dim = shown faintly through · hide · show = drawn through at full strength.

settings.label: Distance fade
settings.desc: 3D: labels of far boxes fade out; 0 = all labels equally strong.

settings.label: Text blocks on screen
settings.desc: Most text blocks (file columns) drawn at once; the biggest on screen win.

settings.label: Show text from
settings.desc: Line height on screen (px) at which a file starts showing its line texture.

settings.label: Letters appear at
settings.desc: Line height (px) where dashes begin turning into letters.

settings.label: Letters complete at
settings.desc: Line height (px) where letters are fully shown.

settings.label: Letter weight
settings.desc: Glyph coverage curve: lower = bolder small text.

settings.label: Roof text color
settings.desc: syntax: colored code · mono: one calm tone · auto: mono from afar, syntax colors once letters are readable.

settings.label: Mono tone
settings.desc: The single tone of mono roof text.

settings.label: Roof lift
settings.desc: Lightens roofs that carry text, for contrast behind the code.

settings.label: Box outline
settings.desc: Width of box outlines in pixels (times interface scale). In 2D they snap to whole pixels, so every line has the same weight.

settings.label: Outline boxes from
settings.desc: Boxes smaller than this on screen (px) are drawn as solid cells without an outline.

settings.label: Nesting tone
settings.desc: How much lighter the fill of deeper-nested boxes gets, so nesting reads without relying on line weight.

settings.label: Selection outline
settings.desc: Width of the selection outline in pixels.

settings.label: Hover outline
settings.desc: Width of the hover outline in pixels.

settings.label: Functions
settings.desc: Outline functions and methods inside files.

settings.label: Classes and types
settings.desc: Outline classes, types and namespaces inside files.

settings.label: Opacity
settings.desc: Strength of scope outlines.

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.desc: Rounded corners of scope outlines (px).

settings.label: Dashed containers
settings.desc: Classes, types and namespaces get a dashed outline, functions a solid one.

settings.label: Nested fade
settings.desc: How much fainter each nesting level inside a file gets.

settings.label: Roof fill
settings.desc: colored: roofs take their area or lens color, the map reads as a colored city · dark: roofs are dark code rooms as soon as a box is a few pixels big · auto: colored from afar, dark once a box is big enough to read its code.

settings.label: Lighting
settings.desc: directional: walls and bevels shaded by one light · flat: no shading.

settings.label: Light follows
settings.desc: camera: a headlight that turns with the view, so every face you look at reads (like Softimage) · world: a fixed sun, direction and height below.

settings.label: Ambient
settings.desc: Light that reaches every face. Lower = deeper shadows and stronger volume.

settings.label: Specular
settings.desc: Strength of the shiny highlight on faces and edges turned toward the light.

settings.label: Glossiness
settings.desc: Size of the specular highlight: low = broad sheen, high = tight glint.

settings.label: Diffuse-only roofs
settings.desc: Keep specular off the top planes (where the code is): all roofs · only the selected box · none.

settings.label: Light direction
settings.desc: Where the light comes from, around the city (degrees).

settings.label: Light height
settings.desc: Light elevation above the ground (degrees).

settings.label: Light strength
settings.desc: Contrast between lit and shaded faces.

settings.label: Contact shading
settings.desc: Walls darken toward their base so terraces and steps read.

settings.label: Area palette
settings.desc: Hues of the top-level areas: soft pastels, near-neutral greys, or an instrument-panel cyan family.

settings.label: Focus dimming
settings.desc: 2D: while a search or relation arcs are shown, dim everything else by this much. 0 = off.

settings.label: Selection
settings.desc: Outline and tint of the selected box.

settings.label: Hover
settings.desc: Outline of the box under the cursor.

settings.label: Search hits
settings.desc: Files and lines matching the current search.

settings.label: Selection style
settings.desc: silhouette: one clean outline around the selected box, drawn over everything · tint: the box glows in the selection color · both · off.

settings.label: Tint strength
settings.desc: How strongly the tint style colors the selected box (walls and roof).

settings.label: Hover style
settings.desc: How the box under the cursor is marked (same styles as the selection).

settings.label: Show imports
settings.desc: Arcs from the selection to what it imports and from what imports it.

settings.label: Show calls
settings.desc: Arcs to what the selected function or file calls and from its callers. Syntax-level: ambiguous names are skipped.

settings.label: Imports
settings.desc: Arcs from the selection to what it imports.

settings.label: Imported by
settings.desc: Arcs from files that import the selection.

settings.label: Calls
settings.desc: Arcs from the selection to what it calls.

settings.label: Called by
settings.desc: Arcs from callers of the selection.

settings.label: Arc opacity
settings.desc: Strongest arc opacity; many arcs fade toward a fifth of it.

settings.label: Arc width (2D)
settings.desc: Arc line width in pixels on the flat map.

settings.label: Direction
settings.desc: Draw outgoing arcs (what the selection uses), incoming (what uses it), or both.

settings.label: Most arcs
settings.desc: Arcs drawn at most per relation.

settings.label: Arc height
settings.desc: How high arcs rise, relative to the distance they span.

settings.label: Arrowheads
settings.desc: Mark the target end of each arc (2D).

settings.label: Group small endpoints
settings.desc: 2D: endpoints smaller than this on screen (px) share arcs; the arc gets thicker with the count. 0 = never group.

settings.label: Arcs through buildings
settings.desc: 3D: arcs stay visible behind buildings.

settings.label: 3D tile budget
settings.desc: Most map tiles drawn at once in the 3D city.

settings.label: Tile cache
settings.desc: Tiles kept in memory after they leave the view.

settings.label: Vendored
settings.desc: Area kept by third-party code checked into the repo (vendor/, third_party/, *.min.js …) when Importance is on.

settings.label: Tests
settings.desc: Area kept by tests, specs, fixtures and snapshots.

settings.label: Generated / minified
settings.desc: Area kept by files with very long lines.

settings.label: Assets
settings.desc: Area kept by images, fonts, media, archives, source maps and lockfiles.

settings.label: Data / config
settings.desc: Area kept by JSON, YAML, TOML and similar files.

settings.label: Rules
settings.desc: Glob = weight, separated by ; (e.g. src/legacy/** = 0.3; **/*.stories.tsx = 0.2). A repo's .scrap.json can add its own.

settings.label: Order
settings.desc: How siblings are placed: size = biggest first · name = alphabetical (boxes move least when lenses or files change) · kind = folders first, then files, each alphabetical.

settings.label: Layout
settings.desc: squarified = the squarest boxes, but the order winds around the space · strip = rows in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), slightly longer boxes.

settings.label: Diagnostics overlay
settings.desc: Frame time, tile and text streaming counters in the viewport corner (F12).

settings.label: Git history window
settings.desc: How far back git lenses look (git date syntax: 12.months, 2.years, 2025-01-01). Empty = whole history, which can take minutes on big repositories.
